results.original_prompt:
This part is a thin, irregular stepped plate built by five small planar profiles extruded and unioned; the main profile is an organic outline with multiple arcs and straight edges and three additional arc/rounded pieces and a rectangular-ish appendage are unioned to it. Overall thickness is produced by 2-unit extrusions of each sketch.

Setup: all sketches are drawn on the XY plane. The sketches are placed at these workplane origins: the first workplane at (16, 6, -1); the second workplane at (-99, 48, -1); the third workplane at (-99, 48, -1) (same as the second); the fourth workplane at (-33, 53, -1); and the fifth workplane at (-65, 6, -1). No rotations are applied.

Build description:
- Start with the main base outline on the XY plane at origin (16,6,-1). Sketch the closed profile by following these edges in order: segment from (0,0) to (7,0); arc from (7,0) through (31,-10) to (41,-34); segment to (41,-79); small arc from (41,-79) through (42,-81) to (44,-81); segment to (81,-81); arc from (81,-81) through (83,-81) to (84,-79); segment to (84,8); arc from (84,8) through (74,32) to (50,42); segment to (0,42); back to (0,0). Extrude that closed sketch 2 in the positive normal direction.
- Create the first auxiliary cap at workplane (-99,48,-1): sketch a closed shape formed by an arc from (0,0) through (34,-42) to (68,0) and the straight segment from (68,0) back to (0,0). Extrude that sketch 2 in the positive normal direction and union it with the base.
- At the same workplane (-99,48,-1) sketch the complementary closed shape formed by the straight segment from (0,0) to (68,0) and an arc from (68,0) through (34,27) to (0,0). Extrude 2 in the positive normal direction and union it.
- At workplane (-33,53,-1) sketch a small closed rounded feature: arc from (0,0) through (1,-3) to (2,-5), segment to (8,-5), and arc from (8,-5) through (3,-4) back to (0,0). Extrude that sketch 2 in the positive normal direction and union it.
- At workplane (-65,6,-1) sketch the rectangular/filleted appendage by following: segment from (0,0) to (82,0), segment to (82,42), segment to (40,42), segment to (34,42), then arc from (34,42) through (27,13) back to (0,0). Extrude that closed sketch 2 in the positive normal direction and union it with the existing solid.

The final solid is the union of those five 2-unit-thick extruded sketches positioned by their respective workplane origins.
